explanation: Fires on the token just before a noun naming a relation between two things: the second term of 'X-to-Y ratio' (performance-to-cost, debt-income, buck-to-doe, employment-population) and the article/modifier before 'relationship/distinction/link/gap between' or 'hybrid of the two'. Weaker firing on other two-term compounds (small-size/big-performance, Human-ET).
